newsitem.title: MEXICO: Cayo Arcas oil shipping port open - Pemex.
newsitem.headline: Cayo Arcas oil shipping port open - Pemex.

text.p: The Pemex shipping port Cayo Arcas on the Gulf of Mexico is open, Pemex said Wednesday.
The state-owned oil company's two other main shipping ports on the Gulf of Mexico, Pajaritos and Dos Bocas, remain closed from Tuesday night due to bad weather. Wind gusts had reached up to 40 knots.
A Pemex spokeswoman said Cayo Arcas, in Campeche state, was not adversely affected by the storm front that hit Pajaritos and Dos Bocas in the more northern states of Veracruz and Tabasco.
Wind speeds at Cayo Arcas reached up to 22 knots, not strong enough to halt crude oil shipping, said Belisario Velazquez, director of pilot boats at the Cayo Arcas port.
